# Pull request

## Change and reason

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue or spec and state the scope.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results, including `corepack pnpm check` when applicable. State any checks or acceptance criteria that remain unverified.

## Review context

Explain the areas needing close review, relevant risks and any data or external-effect changes. Keep secrets, private Project data and vulnerability details out of this public pull request. For security concerns, read SECURITY.md in the repository root.
